decision_summary: Self-review confirms v0.6.31 adds reproducible calibration-report structure without turning confidence, probability, Brier score, sample size, or verifier success into quality truth.
rationale: Visionary: the package makes confidence accountable to outcomes. Builder: references, arithmetic, bucket coverage, sufficiency, signals, and fixture drift are deterministic. Guardian: source confidence and probability meaning remain separate review concerns; original outcome provenance resolves; example data stays non-empirical and insufficient; every adverse boundary routes to governance.
recommendation: Proceed to final repository checks and release review after recording runtime evidence and the next value slice.
target_audience: release operator and QIF governance owner
expected_user_reaction: The release is understandable, auditable, and appropriately cautious about what its calculations mean.
